description: Oyster Growers Prepare for Changing Ocean Chemistry is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Mook Sea Farm; University of New Hampshire | Institute for the Study of Earth, Oceans, and Space; NOAA | Ocean Acidification Program. As the ocean absorbs carbon dioxide, ocean acidity changes, inhibiting the growth of oysters. A new tool may be able to help oyster growers understand how they will be affected. Coverage: the United States (2017). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
